title: Monitorul Query Logs
description: Operational metrics for the Elasticsearch query log index configured by QUERY_LOG_INDEX.

data_source.query: FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS `Total queries` = COUNT(*)

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS `Errored queries` = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_ERROR_FIELD}` IS NOT NULL, 1, null))

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS queries = COUNT(*), errors = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_ERROR_FIELD}` IS NOT NULL, 1, null)) | EVAL `Error rate` = CASE(queries > 0, errors * 100.0 / queries, 0.0)

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS queries = COUNT(*), zero_results = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_TOTAL_FIELD}` <= 0, 1, null)) | EVAL `Zero-result rate` = CASE(queries > 0, zero_results * 100.0 / queries, 0.0)
FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS `Avg latency` = AVG(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`)
FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS `P50 latency` = PERCENTILE(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`, 50)
FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS `P95 latency` = PERCENTILE(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`, 95)
FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS `P99 latency` = PERCENTILE(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`, 99)

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS queries = COUNT(*), errors = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_ERROR_FIELD}` IS NOT NULL, 1, null)) BY BUCKET(`${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}`, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS avg_ms = AVG(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`, 95), p99_ms = PERCENTILE(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`, 99) BY BUCKET(`${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}`, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS queries = COUNT(*), errors = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_ERROR_FIELD}` IS NOT NULL, 1, null)), zero_results = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_TOTAL_FIELD}` <= 0, 1, null)) BY BUCKET(`${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}`, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL error_rate = CASE(queries > 0, errors * 100.0 / queries, 0.0), zero_result_rate = CASE(queries > 0, zero_results * 100.0 / queries, 0.0)

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS queries = COUNT(*) BY `${QUERY_LOG_NAME_FIELD}` | SORT queries DESC | LIMIT 12

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS queries = COUNT(*), errors = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_ERROR_FIELD}` IS NOT NULL, 1, null)), zero_results = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_TOTAL_FIELD}` <= 0, 1, null)), avg_ms = AVG(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`, 95) BY `${QUERY_LOG_SURFACE_FIELD}` | EVAL error_rate = CASE(queries > 0, errors * 100.0 / queries, 0.0), zero_result_rate = CASE(queries > 0, zero_results * 100.0 / queries, 0.0) | SORT queries DESC

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS queries = COUNT(*), zero_results = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_TOTAL_FIELD}` <= 0, 1, null)), avg_ms = AVG(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`, 95) BY `${QUERY_LOG_RANK_FUSION_FIELD}` | EVAL zero_result_rate = CASE(queries > 0, zero_results * 100.0 / queries, 0.0) | SORT queries DESC

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart AND `${QUERY_LOG_ERROR_FIELD}` IS NOT NULL | STATS queries = COUNT(*) BY `${QUERY_LOG_ERROR_FIELD}` | SORT queries DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS queries = COUNT(*), errors = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_ERROR_FIELD}` IS NOT NULL, 1, null)), zero_results = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_TOTAL_FIELD}` <= 0, 1, null)), avg_ms = AVG(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`, 95), p99_ms = PERCENTILE(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`, 99) BY `${QUERY_LOG_NAME_FIELD}`, `${QUERY_LOG_SURFACE_FIELD}` | EVAL error_rate = CASE(queries > 0, errors * 100.0 / queries, 0.0), zero_result_rate = CASE(queries > 0, zero_results * 100.0 / queries, 0.0) | SORT p99_ms DESC | LIMIT 25

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart AND `${QUERY_LOG_ES_DURATION_FIELD}` IS NOT NULL | EVAL app_overhead_ms = `${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}` - `${QUERY_LOG_ES_DURATION_FIELD}` | STATS queries = COUNT(*), avg_ms = AVG(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`), avg_es_ms = AVG(`${QUERY_LOG_ES_DURATION_FIELD}`), avg_overhead_ms = AVG(app_overhead_ms), p95_overhead_ms = PERCENTILE(app_overhead_ms, 95) BY `${QUERY_LOG_NAME_FIELD}`, `${QUERY_LOG_SURFACE_FIELD}` | SORT avg_overhead_ms DESC | LIMIT 25

FROM ${QUERY_LOG_INDEX} | WHERE `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` <= ?_tend AND `${QUERY_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FIELD}` > ?_tstart | STATS queries = COUNT(*), zero_results = COUNT(CASE(`${QUERY_LOG_TOTAL_FIELD}` <= 0, 1, null)), avg_ms = AVG(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(`${QUERY_LOG_DURATION_FIELD}`, 95) BY `${QUERY_LOG_NAME_FIELD}`, `${QUERY_LOG_SURFACE_FIELD}` | WHERE zero_results > 0 | EVAL zero_result_rate = CASE(queries > 0, zero_results * 100.0 / queries, 0.0) | SORT zero_results DESC | LIMIT 25
